content: Yesu hiꞌahiꞌa ꞌipaꞌidiya ma sihapwesa
Eema sihabala ma siluhuwa meGelasine ꞌidi gadowa.
Siluhuwa ma Yesu ꞌisuluwa dabala ma loheya ꞌaigeda ꞌilobeya hiꞌahiꞌa* ꞌoina, ꞌina ꞌebemiyaina beno duluha, ꞌoinega ꞌilatuma,

ma duluhaina beno tomota ꞌadi galiha. Ma loheya bewa mwalo tomota sitohoya ma ꞌabehega sipai gulahega (beno seni ꞌoinega), ma geya sowasowahidi, weyahina gulahaedi sauga baibaiwana ꞌiupaupadi nimanega ma ꞌahenega. Geya ꞌeta sawasawahina ma ꞌiꞌabiyahi, eeta ꞌidena sinediya ma ꞌitauya pwatula.
Nihuwana ma sabwelo mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya galiha ma ꞌoyai ꞌiꞌasoꞌasona, ma taunamo daꞌuleyega ꞌihunuhunu hila.
Ma loheyainaina Yesu bwagebwagega ꞌiꞌiteyama, ma ꞌipilima ta Yesu matana ꞌiꞌetuluha.
Cabwa tuwa ꞌiꞌasoꞌasona ma ꞌigwae, “Yesu yo, ꞌowa Yehoba tohewaiwai hedada Natuna, toꞌaha ꞌabehega ꞌutohotoho ma ꞌupaihowa ꞌoiguwa? Yaꞌahwanoi ꞌoiuwa Yehoba saninega sahena ꞌuꞌabiꞌabi hemuyemuyegau.”
Gwae bewa ꞌigwaeneya weyahina Yesu ꞌihegwae pwaiya, ꞌigwaeya, “Hiꞌahiꞌa, loheya bewa ꞌoinega ꞌulatu.”
Ma Yesu wete ꞌihesilala ꞌigwae, “Togidega saniu?” Ma tauna ꞌigwaeya, “Sanigu Baibaiwa Hedada, weyahina mabodaima loheya bewa ꞌalona ꞌamiyamiya.”
Ma ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌoheꞌohe Yesu ꞌoina, ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena ꞌasa bewa ꞌoinega ꞌuulaula latuhemai.
Ma hesi ꞌuhewasaemai ma ꞌaluhu bawe bodaidi nage siduladula ꞌoyai.”

Yesu ꞌitagwalediya ma hiꞌahiꞌaedi loheyaina ꞌoinega silatuwa ma siluhuwa bawe ꞌoidiya, eeta baweyedi sihebuwa ma mabwaiyadi sipili butubutuwa, ma ꞌadeꞌadewala siꞌeloula holai ma sidamana. Baweyedi ꞌadi baibaiwa gide tutausani.

Coinega bawe ꞌadi toꞌitayahinao ꞌidi matautega sidena ma silatuwa ꞌasai, ma ginauledi siꞌitediya mabwaiyana sihewasaediya ꞌasa madouna ma ꞌasa ꞌiꞌiudi tomotaedi ꞌoidiya. Coinega toniꞌasa sinaoma ma ꞌabehega siboimo matadiyega siꞌita togidega ta ꞌilatuwa.
Coinega Yesu ꞌoina sinaoma, ma loheyaina siꞌiteya, mwalo hiꞌahiꞌa ꞌalona simiyamiya, debana ꞌidumwaluwa ma ꞌaleꞌo ꞌiꞌoteya ta ꞌimiyamiya. Nage ꞌoina mabwaiyadi siꞌateyohowa.
Coinega tohalewasaedi tomota ꞌoidiya siheꞌoteꞌoteteleya togidega loheyaina ꞌibwebweꞌana ꞌesa ma bawe togidega sihesilae ꞌesa.
Nage ꞌoina toniꞌasa sihegaina ma Yesu silososomane ma ꞌabehega ꞌidi tupwa ꞌiꞌebesine.
Coinega Yesu wagai ꞌidobidobi sabi gelu, ma loheyaina nige ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya Yesu ꞌoina ꞌiꞌahwanoiya, ꞌigwae, “Bada, sawasawahina yamuliyego?”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Geya sawasawahina, ma hesi ꞌuhila ma ꞌutau ꞌino susuwao ꞌoidiya ꞌuheꞌoteꞌotetele Yehoba ꞌina ꞌatemuyemuyega ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanegowa, eema sihesagohe.”
Coinega loheyaina ꞌitauya ꞌebeloina Dikapoli ꞌasaina nima ꞌeluꞌeluwa ꞌoidiya, ma Yesu ꞌina paihowao waiwaidi weyahidi ꞌiheꞌoteꞌotetela, ma tomota mabwaiyadi sihesagoheya, ta nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa.
Yesu wahiwahine ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya
Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sihabala hila, ma boda madouna siꞌautama gadowaina ꞌoina.
Eema loheya ꞌaigeda sanina Yailo, loheyaina tauna hada tapwalolo ꞌana toꞌitayahina, ꞌinaoma ma Yesu ꞌilobeya, ma matana ꞌituluha,
ma ꞌiꞌahwanoi waiwai, ꞌigwaeya, “Bada, natugu mewahinena ꞌana lohala ꞌimwau hedada. Tauna gwamasine tuwa. Nuwanuwagu ꞌunaoma ꞌuꞌabitoho ma ꞌibwebweꞌana, ma sahena ꞌiꞌamaꞌamasa.”
Eeta Yesu baꞌidana sinaonao, ma boda madouna sihehemulitabubu ma siheheduidui ꞌedai.
Bodaedi ꞌalodiya wahine ꞌaigeda baꞌidadiu maꞌana lohala. Lohalaina beno bweyahina ꞌidaudau bolime tuwelo, ta ꞌabwa tuwa ꞌidaudau.
Mwalo toꞌoba baibaiwadi ꞌoidiya ꞌina mane mabwaiyana ꞌilohegumwaliya, ma hesi ꞌidi paihowaina ꞌoina geya ꞌida bwebweꞌana tohona, ma hesi ꞌana lohalaina ꞌimadomadou.
Wahineina Yesu ꞌihemuli tabubuweya weyahina mwalo wasana ꞌihesagoheya, ma ꞌatena ꞌinuwanuwatuhu, ꞌigwaeya, “Ceguma tuwa Yesu ꞌana ꞌaleꞌomo yaꞌabitoho beno nata yabwebweꞌana.”
Coinega ꞌinaowa deina ma ꞌana ꞌaleꞌoina ꞌiꞌabitohoya, ma bweyahina ꞌina dau ꞌilolagu mwayamwayauwa, ma ꞌiboi ꞌana ꞌamna ꞌilotohoya ꞌabehega ꞌibwebweꞌana pwaiya.
Ta Yesu ꞌilotohoya ꞌabehega waiwai ꞌoinega ꞌilatuwa, ma ꞌiꞌita lohihila, ma boda ꞌihesilalediya, ꞌigwae, “Taiya ꞌagu ꞌaleꞌo ꞌiꞌabitohoya?”
Eeta ꞌana tomuliyaowedi sihegwaeya, “Bada, boꞌi ꞌuꞌita pwaiya boda simiya sakowasiyegowa, ma siheheduidui, ma toꞌaha weyahina ꞌuhesilala taiya ꞌiꞌabi tohogowa?”
Ma Yesu ꞌiloꞌita dadana ma ꞌabehega ꞌiꞌita taiya ꞌina waiwai ꞌoina ꞌihabala.

Ma wahineina ꞌiboi ꞌilotohoya nage ꞌoina bwebweꞌana ꞌilobeya, ma ꞌinaoma maꞌina dedela ma wete maꞌina ꞌateyoho, eeta ꞌibeꞌuwa ma ꞌiꞌeno talutalubuꞌiya Yesu matana, ꞌihepwaila bwaibwaina ꞌabehega tauna ꞌipaihoweya.
Eeta Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Natugu, ꞌino hemisega ta ꞌubwebweꞌana. Cutoholo maꞌino yaliyaya ꞌutau. Cino lohalao mabwaiyana sigumwala pwaiya.”
Saugaina ꞌoina Yesu ꞌigwaegwae wahineina ꞌoina, ma tupwadi loheloheya wasa siꞌeweyama Yailo ꞌina hadega, sigwaeya, “Natuu yawasina ꞌigumwala, ma sahena wete toheꞌitaina ꞌina sauga ꞌuꞌabiꞌabiyahi.”
Ma Yesu wete wasaina ꞌihesagoheya, ta Yailo ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena ꞌuꞌateꞌateyoho, ma hesi ꞌuhemisegau.”
Coinega Yesu boda madouna ꞌiꞌausidiya ma sahena simulimuliye, ma hesi ꞌana tomuliyao sitetoi baꞌidanao, beno Pita ma Yemesa ma tasina tauna Yoni,
sinaonao ta Yailo ꞌina hada silatuwa, ma wui ma dou madouna sihesagoheya.
Ta Yesu ꞌiluhuwa ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Toꞌaha weyahina wawuiwui ma wadoudou? Gwama bewa geya ꞌiꞌamasa, tuwa ꞌiꞌenoꞌeno.” Ma sihenamaeya.
Sihehenama, eeta Yesu ꞌipaꞌidiya ta silatuwa ꞌatamana, ma gwama tamana ma sinana maꞌana tomuliyao sitetoiyedi Yesu baꞌidanao siluhuwa gwamaina ꞌina ꞌebeꞌenowa.
Ma gwamaina nimana Yesu ꞌiꞌabiya ma ꞌigwaeya, “Talita kumi.” Ma ꞌana bui, “Gwamasine ꞌutoholoma.”
Nage ꞌoina ꞌitoholo mwayamwayauwa ma ꞌiyawala, weyahina ꞌana bolime tuwelo ꞌilobeya. Tamana ma sinana nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa moisa.
Ma Yesu ꞌiꞌausidiya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena taiya ꞌeta ꞌoina wahehepwaila ꞌigu paihowa bewa weyahina, ma hesi gwama ꞌana waꞌebwae ma ꞌiꞌai.”
